limits: No Blender, GPU, browser, services, database or network execution.
No commits, installs, PRs or merges.
Inputs are producer receipts; publication checks their hashes and coverage without rerunning receipt producers.
Input files must be quiescent during publication; command histories must be frozen if runners append later.
If a read-only filesystem prevents both pointer replacement and deletion, the invocation exits nonzero and cannot revoke an existing pointer.
Concurrency test holds the real publisher lock and runs the actual CLI loser; it does not launch two simultaneously successful publishers.
